statement: Beijing has signaled it intends to approve purchases by ByteDance, Alibaba and other domestic firms of a new Nvidia professional-workstation chip (reported as the RTX PRO 5500) that executives expect to fall outside U.S. export restrictions.
why: An approval signal from China's industry ministry would reopen a large licensed demand channel for Nvidia silicon that export controls had largely closed.

impact.mechanism: Chinese regulatory approval plus a restriction-compliant part lets large Chinese platforms buy U.S. accelerators again, adding licensed unit demand.

evidence.excerpt: The Chinese government has signaled it could allow some domestic companies, including ByteDance and Alibaba, to buy a new Nvidia chip for high-end professional computers

confidence.basis: Secondary re-reporting of a single outlet's two anonymous sources; Reuters stated it could not immediately verify the report.
